source.text: 饭没吃上，前台点餐的一位年轻女服务员态度极差，知道我和朋友一起准备坐下，我一个人吃之后，先试图让我们两个人坐在都是餐具杂物的一人桌，被拒绝后又找借口不给点餐让排在我后面的客人先买单，各种拖延，太棒了🫶🫶
source.textTranslated: I didn't get to eat, and the young female server at the counter was extremely rude. Knowing my friend and I were about to sit down together, she tried to seat us at a table full of cutlery and other miscellaneous items after I decided to eat alone. When I refused, she made excuses not to take my order and made the customer behind me pay first, stalling me in every way possible. It was just awful! 🫶🫶

claims.text: the young female server at the counter was extremely rude
the table was full of cutlery and other miscellaneous items
the customer behind me paid first
she made excuses not to take my order

reference.notes: The closing 太棒了 is sarcasm (the translation renders it 'awful'), so it is negative. The aspect for the cluttered one-person table is ambiguous between dining_area, space and wait_for_table. The ordering and queue-jumping claims sit between queue, attentiveness and service.
